rows.title: Stop what shouldn't move
rows.body: Sanctions and fraud screening run as a policy condition before signing. A flagged or unauthorized transaction never reaches the chain.
rows.proof: Policy engine · Governance engine · KYT screening

rows.title: AML data in the flow
rows.body: Originator and beneficiary data travels inside the payload, per Transfer of Funds Regulation requirements.

rows.title: Hand an auditor proof
rows.body: Every action is written to a tamper-evident, exportable log, and attestation shows the policies you configured ran. Acceptable evidence, not screenshots.
rows.proof: Audit Logs · Attestations · Exportable to your SIEM

rows.title: DORA on resilience and exit
rows.body: Active-active continuity, geo-redundancy, self-host data where your regulator requires, and the exit is built in, so you are never locked to a single vendor.
rows.proof: On-premise deployments · Code escrow · Backups & DRP
